description.value: The Juice Truck began as a cold-pressed juice food truck on a Vancouver street corner and has grown into a plant-based wellness brand with brick-and-mortar juice bars and an online marketplace. The 4420 Lougheed Highway location offers made-to-order cold-pressed juices, wellness shots, cleanses, and a range of plant-based grocery and supplement products. Everything on the menu is vegetarian and vegan, with organic produce sourced where available.
